name: Torralba de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torralba de Calatrava (a cross of Calatrava on white above a tower on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Torralba de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torralba de Calatrava arms — cross of Calatrava above a tower
